info.title: API.SH: VS Code Marketplace
info.description: The VS Code Marketplace API from API.SH: public VS Code Marketplace data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.summary: VS Code Marketplace publisher and its extensions
get.description:
A publisher (display name, verified badge, verified domain) and its VS Code extensions with installs, ratings and versions; `total` is its extension count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vscode-publisher

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Publisher id (the part before the dot in an extension id) or publisher page link.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

The text of an extension's README or changelog (Markdown), its license, or its package.json manifest (JSON: contributes, activation events, commands, settings, scripts), for the latest version.

get.description:
User reviews of an extension, newest first: star rating, text, date, extension version and the publisher's reply; `total` is the full review count. Reviewers are shown by their display name, as on the Marketplace page. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vscode-reviews

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Searches the Visual Studio Code Marketplace by words, category and tag, sorted by relevance, installs, rating, trending, update or publish date. Each extension comes with publisher (verified or not), version, categories, tags, installs, downloads, rating, rating count, trending scores and dates; `total` is the full match count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vscode-search

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category, e.g. Programming Languages, Linters, Themes, Debuggers, Formatters, Snippets, Keymaps, Data Science, Machine Learning, Notebooks, AI, Chat, Testing, Extension Packs, Language Packs, SCM Providers, Other.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default relevance with q, installs without).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every published version of an extension, newest first, per platform (win32-x64, linux-arm64, darwin-arm64, web ...), with its date and flags (pre-release, validated). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vscode-versions

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Only builds for this platform, e.g. win32-x64, linux-x64, darwin-arm64, alpine-x64, web or universal.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
